profile.headline: Senior Web Developer, WordPress Developer, Magento Developer
profile.summary: I have been working as Website Developer for 10+ years of experience in implementing, developing and maintaining websites using CMS frameworks such as Wordpress, Drupal and eCommerce websites using Magento 2. I am strongly interested in Internet-related services and products.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
- Working as freelancer for some small projects on Freelancer.com, UpWork.com, and Guru.com
- Most of the projects are WordPress CMS with upgrade, customize plugin and change theme layout.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed, implemented, troubleshoot, debug, test, ensure browser compatibility, and fix bugs for the website by using the internal framework, Wordpress, Drupal, Magento 2.
•	Installed, updated, customized third-party modules/plugins to matching with client requirements.
•	Created custom plugins or functions based on client requirements such as import products data from text, CSV file, push order detail to 3rd party API. Google Map finder…
•	Maintained and optimized website to minimize load and processing time based on GTMetrix results.
•	Supported front-end development team to match client requirements.
•	Coordinated with other developers on the delivery of application code.
•	Trained, managed and provided guidance to junior software development staff.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed, implemented, troubleshoot, debug, test, ensure browser compatibility, and fix bugs for the website by using Wordpress and the internal framework.
•	Integrated front-end element and website layout created by front-end developers.
•	Collaborated with testing teams to identify and solve both development and live issues.
•	Optimized website to get the best SEO results.
•	Worked closely with PM and team on change request functions.
•	Liaised with network administrators, project manager, tester, and other programmers to resolve any defects in products or company systems.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Acted as a team leader to collaborate with team members to make the internal web-based application. 
•	In charge of integrated website with Google Analytic to display SEO result for the customer. 
•	Developed ERP system (Sales order system) by using PHP, JQuery and MySQL.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Maintained professional and technical knowledge by going to Malaysia for EDI training in 3 months.
•	Designed and implemented the Billing System website for internal use in PHP and MySQL.
•	Participated in EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) system by multiple programming languages.
Performed as IT support to help customer to change their EDI systems in both C/C++, C#, and PHP

positions.title: Software Programmer
positions.description: Developed web applications using Java and .NET for Japan market.

educations.schoolName: University Of Economics Ho Chi Minh City

volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Designs, implements and maintains the association’s website. Administrative server, domain, mail group and related things in IT department.
•	Assist the Chief Group with the presentation of the monthly meeting and annual events.
•	Responsible for maintaining all the records, materials, forms and the list of members and leaders, up-to-date to help leader function effectively.
•	Worked in IT department to update news, taking photos, recording video clips of events and upload to the website.
Direct, edit and work as editor of the yearbook and other printable design events.
